title: The motel desk, empty
logline: The night desk at 3 AM with no clerk. The bell. The register. The hum line under a private page, the only time.

panels.composition: The motel's night desk at 3 AM from the lobby: the bell, the register open, the chair pushed back, no one in it, the glass door onto the dark lot. Beneath the whole page, once in Vol. II: the flat unbroken line.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a motel night desk at 3 AM with a bell and an open register and an empty pushed-back chair, a glass door onto a dark lot, a flat unbroken line running beneath the entire page, no words
image.notes: The hum line's only appearance in the private pages. Under the whole page.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Absent. The hum for no one, once.
